name: Refraction
description: A light ray bending as it passes from one medium into another, by Snell's law

params.name: theta
params.label: Incoming angle
params.tooltip: Between the ray and the normal, -89 to 89 degrees; below 0 the ray comes from the right

params.name: v1
params.label: Top speed
params.tooltip: How fast light travels in the top medium

params.name: v2
params.label: Bottom speed
params.tooltip: How fast light travels in the bottom medium. Faster than the top can reflect the ray back up

params.name: depth
params.label: Depth
params.tooltip: Height of each medium, above and below the boundary

params.name: ray_length
params.label: Ray length
params.tooltip: Length of the ray on each side of the boundary. It stops at the edge of the media

params.name: normal_length
params.label: Normal length
params.tooltip: Length of the normal line on each side of the boundary, at most the depth

params.name: line_color
params.label: Line color
params.tooltip: Color of the normal line and the angle arcs
